answer: Each submission hangs on the copper of a task receipt, and the falcon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. What survives to the haven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
